title: @worldsdev/Tools
subtitle: TypeScript utility library for arrays, text formatting, HTML transformation, and file downloads
challenge: Design a reusable, modular utility library that provides robust text and array manipulation capabilities while maintaining clean separation of concerns and extensibility. The solution needed to handle HTML sanitization, complex string replacements, and browser-based file downloads in an Angular-compatible way.
architecture: Inheritance-based utility hierarchy (TextTool → RemoveReplaceOption → HtmlTextTool) with composition pattern for rule-based operations. Each tool class encapsulates specific domain logic (arrays, text, downloads) with extensible interfaces for flexible replacement and removal rules.
